description: A massive, red-skinned humanoid in heavy armor fills the picture from the waist up, facing the viewer, seen from the party's eye level. Its face is crimson with a heavy brow, a yellow eye and a snarling mouth, framed by a silver helm with two curved horns. It wears a broad silver breastplate, overlapping scale plates over the shoulders and belly, and red cloth sleeves showing at the upper arms. Its right hand holds a spiked silver mace raised beside its head on the left of the picture. A sword hangs at its hip on the right. The background is a flat bright cyan. The mood is proud and threatening. Frame 1: its free hand rests on the sword hilt at its hip; this is held long. Frame 2: the hand lifts off the hilt briefly. Frame 3: the hand rests on its hip, elbow out. Frame 4: the hand flashes back toward the hilt. The loop reads as a slow, impatient shift between gripping the sword and standing akimbo.
title: Red-faced armored brute with mace
